name: GA Day Camp
description_short: Weekly day camp on Germantown Academy's 126 acre Fort Washington campus, grouped by grade from pre K to grade 8, with swimming in an indoor pool, ropes, zip line, archery, sports, arts and STEM; older campers add field trips.
refund_policy_summary: Before May 1, cancel for a refund minus the $150 deposit. After May 1, refunds need the $60 a week Refund Protection bought before May 1 and return 75% of unused fees; full refunds only for documented medical reasons.
swim_waterfront_notes: 25 yard indoor pool with certified lifeguards; grades 1 to 3 mix instructional and free swim daily, grades 4 to 5 have free swim.
notes: 2026 weekly fees by group (grade entering in fall): Adventurers pre K to K (ages 4 and 5) $535; Pathfinders and Trailblazers grades 1 to 5 $520; Travelers grade 6 $585 (field trips Tuesday and Thursday); Explorers grades 7 to 8 $625 (four field trips a week); CIT program for grade 9. Session prices shown are the grades 1 to 5 rate. Camp 9 am to 3:30 pm; AM extended day 8 to 9 am $75 a week, PM to 4:30 pm $75 or to 5:30 pm $100 a week. Campers pack lunch; optional pizza Wednesdays. Grades 1 to 5 are grouped in same grade, same sex troops. GA also runs sports and specialty camps. Summer 2027 dates and prices are not posted yet.
